# First Mate

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Matey  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P26](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0026)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The First Mate is a large, effulgent, orange-colored cat with a face as round as a full moon and vivid green eyes. He has immense, white, double paws and can curl up into a big, warm, velvety, golden ball.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

## Personality

The First Mate is known for his sociable nature and for being a exceptionally good listener, even though he is not much of a conversationalist himself. Additionally, he holds a strong prejudice against dogs.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P27](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)_

## Goals

## History

Nine years prior, First Mate was abandoned to starve during the winter by summer residents and got caught in a tree by his ribbon collar, but he was rescued by Captain Jim. He became Captain Jim's beloved cat, living with him at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse and welcoming visitors like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). During autumn and winter gatherings, First Mate spent pleasant evenings at the lighthouse in the company of Captain Jim and his guests.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), +6 more_
